in_marathi.name: Reshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun, Light, Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Reshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Reshi is a Sanskrit and Hindi name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rishabh' meaning 'a person who leads or rules'. This name is often associated with the Sun God, symbolizing the radiance, intelligence, and knowledge that comes with enlightenment. It is also believed to bring good fortune and prosperity.
